title: Pip Finds Nell in the Rain Tub
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ch as k/sh, ow as oa.

pages.brief: Nell the bee landing on the curved wooden rim of a tall rain barrel.
Nell the bee tumbling down into the dark water inside the rain barrel.
Pip the sparrow hopping past the tall barrel, unable to see inside it.
Pip the sparrow pausing beside the rain barrel, head tilted, listening.
Pip the sparrow hopping up onto the wooden rim of the rain barrel.
Pip the sparrow looking down and spotting Nell the bee struggling in the water below.
Pip the sparrow picking up a long, thin plant stem from the grass nearby.
Pip the sparrow lowering the stem down into the rain barrel toward Nell.
Nell the bee gripping the stem tightly and climbing up it out of the water.
Nell the bee standing on the rim beside Pip, damp but smiling with relief.
